import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Solution {
    private static class Scanner {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public Scanner(InputStream input) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(input));
            tokenizer = null;
        }

        public Scanner() {
            this(System.in);
        }

        private String nextToken() throws IOException {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public String next() {
            try {
                return nextToken();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                System.err.println(e);
                return null;
            }
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        public double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }

        public String nextLine() {
            try {
                if (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                }
                return tokenizer.nextToken("\n");
            } catch (IOException e) {
                System.err.println(e);
                return "";
            }
        }
    }

    private static final long MOD = 998244353L;
    private static final int MAX_N = 200005;
    private static final long[] factorial = new long[MAX_N];

    private static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        if (exp == 0) return 1L;
        if (exp % 2 == 1) return base * modPow(base, exp - 1, mod) % mod;
        return modPow(base * base % mod, exp / 2, mod) % mod;
    }

    private static long nCr(int n, int r) {
        if (r > n) return 0L;
        return factorial[n] * modPow(factorial[r], MOD - 2, MOD) % MOD
                * modPow(factorial[n - r], MOD - 2, MOD) % MOD;
    }

    private static long compute(int n, int k) {
        long result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - k; i++) {
            long term = nCr(n - k, i) * modPow(n - k - i, n, MOD) % MOD;
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                result = (result + term) % MOD;
            } else {
                result = (result - term + MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner();
        int t = 1;
        for (int caseNum = 1; caseNum <= t; caseNum++) {
            long n = scanner.nextLong();
            long k = scanner.nextLong();

            factorial[0] = 1;
            for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                factorial[(int) i] = factorial[(int) (i - 1)] * i % MOD;
            }

            if (k >= n) {
                System.out.println(0);
            } else if (k == 0) {
                System.out.println(factorial[(int) n]);
            } else {
                long comb = nCr((int) n, (int) (n - k));
                long solveResult = compute((int) n, (int) k);
                System.out.println(2 * comb % MOD * solveResult % MOD);
            }
        }
    }
}
